component: Real-incident benchmark population and reproducible provenance
chronosaudit_requirement: Real incidents with immutable case-level provenance and prediction-time artifacts.
closest_predecessor_label: CyberChainBench; SCONE-bench; EVMbench; DAppSCAN; SCDBench; SC-Bench
verified_overlap: Real incidents, benchmark provenance, paired source/bytecode corpora, and public benchmark packaging are already established.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must show prediction-time admissibility manifests and audit-ready provenance rules rather than claiming novelty for real incidents alone.
defeating_evidence: PA013 and PA012 already use large real-incident corpora; PA010, PA004, PA039, and PA040 show reproducible public benchmark packaging and real-contract datasets.
residual_uncertainty: Whether any predecessor already exposes machine-verifiable admissibility manifests at the case and prediction-time level was not verified in the bounded search.

component: Historical chain-state or executable evidence grading
chronosaudit_requirement: Executable grading through exploit replay, invariant violation, counterexample, or analogous machine-checkable evidence.
closest_predecessor_label: CyberChainBench; EVMbench; SCONE-bench; Truffle Tests for Free; SolidiFI; SCDBench
verified_overlap: Historical replay and executable or replay-based semantic grading are already present in multiple predecessors.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must frame executable evidence as one layer inside a broader admissibility and censor-aware protocol.
defeating_evidence: PA013 reconstructs exploits on historical forks; PA010 and PA012 use executable grading; PA039 adds differential-replay checkpoints; PA018 and PA003 are earlier evidence-generation precursors.
residual_uncertainty: Whether ChronosAudit's proposed evidence ladder has a materially different adjudication contract from these predecessors is still open.

chronosaudit_requirement: Evaluation restricted by deployment or model-release time with explicit pre-cutoff information constraints.
verified_overlap: Post-cutoff and scaffold-sensitive evaluation are already established.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must show that time-only or post-cutoff control is insufficient without lineage, clone, and mechanism separation.
defeating_evidence: PA011 directly defeats novelty of post-cutoff evaluation alone; PA012 also includes a post-knowledge-cutoff subset.
residual_uncertainty: Whether any smart-contract benchmark already ties temporal admissibility to a machine-verifiable manifest for every prediction was not verified.

chronosaudit_requirement: Joint split control across protocol, organization, factory, fork, or upgrade lineage.
closest_predecessor_label: CyberChainBench; Re-Evaluating EVMbench; When Datasets Deceive
verified_overlap: Adjacent benchmarks expose repeated families and contamination concerns but no reviewed source verified a protocol/entity-lineage split as a formal benchmark axis.
material_difference: ChronosAudit needs a reproducible lineage ontology and audit trail that materially changes measured survival.
defeating_evidence: No reviewed predecessor was verified to implement protocol/entity-lineage separation as part of a complete admissibility policy.
residual_uncertainty: Search terminology may have missed lineage controls described as ecosystem, family, project, factory, or upgrade partitioning.

component: Normalized source and bytecode clone separation
chronosaudit_requirement: Joint split control across normalized source-code and bytecode clone families.
closest_predecessor_label: When Datasets Deceive; Clone Detection for Smart Contracts: How Far Are We?
verified_overlap: Clone leakage is already documented and clone-family construction is technically mature enough to benchmark.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must combine clone separation with time, lineage, mechanism, and operational evaluation rather than claiming clone control itself as novel.
defeating_evidence: PA014 directly defeats novelty of overlap-free splitting alone; PA015-PA017 show clone benchmarking and large-scale clone prevalence.
residual_uncertainty: Whether a prior vulnerability benchmark already uses both normalized source and bytecode clone families jointly with other strict controls remains open.

chronosaudit_requirement: Joint split control across proxy implementation families and attacker-contract reuse.
closest_predecessor_label: CyberChainBench; SoK: Root Cause; OWASP SCSVS; BlockWatchdog; Evil Under the Sun; ERC-1167
verified_overlap: Proxy-aware verification, standardized clone bytecode, attacker-contract analysis, exploit reuse, campaign structure, and execution-trace clustering are established. No reviewed source verified attacker-clone and proxy-implementation families as formal benchmark split axes.
material_difference: ChronosAudit needs explicit attacker-side and proxy-family leakage rules that are rerunnable and must demonstrate a material performance effect.
defeating_evidence: PA031 defeats novelty of proxy-aware security controls; PA038 defeats novelty of minimal-proxy family recognition; PA034 defeats attacker-contract-aware detection; PA035 defeats novelty of exploit reuse, campaign dependence, and trace clustering.
residual_uncertainty: The targeted search may still miss operational controls described as campaign isolation, infrastructure families, exploit propagation, or implementation lineage; proprietary protocols remain inaccessible.

chronosaudit_requirement: Joint split control across exploit-mechanism or root-cause families.
closest_predecessor_label: Combatting Front-Running...; SoK: Root Cause...; DAppSCAN; SAST Tools; SDABA; SC-Bench
verified_overlap: Mechanism or root-cause taxonomies already exist, and current benchmarks cover broad vulnerability families or auditing-rule violations.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must show cross-mechanism separation as a general admissibility control rather than claiming exploit taxonomy itself is novel.
defeating_evidence: PA007 and PA021 defeat novelty of mechanism-family thinking; PA036 and PA037 add broad current taxonomies; PA040 adds large-scale auditing-rule violations.
residual_uncertainty: Whether any predecessor already enforces exploit-mechanism families as a split axis across a mixed benchmark population remains open.

chronosaudit_requirement: Population model with confirmed positives, mature investigated negatives, and unresolved right-censored contracts.
closest_predecessor_label: FinSurvival; Temporal Web3 Intelligence; Vulnerable Does Not Imply Exploited; Dos and Don'ts of ML in Computer Security; SDABA
verified_overlap: Right-censored Web3 benchmarking, temporal non-stationarity, exploitation sparsity, fixed-version negative evaluation, and security-ML base-rate pitfalls are all established.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must justify an exploit-specific outcome and maturity contract and show that censor-aware inference changes conclusions only when combined with admissibility controls.
defeating_evidence: PA026 and PA027 defeat novelty of right-censored temporal Web3 benchmarks; PA008 and PA022 defeat novelty of the open-world and base-rate motivation; PA037 adds fixed-version negative evaluation but not mature-negative follow-up.
residual_uncertainty: The exploit-specific censoring estimand and its assumptions remain scientifically unverified, but censoring itself is not differentiating.

chronosaudit_requirement: A staged decay study from weak controls to strict joint independence control and then prospective testing.
closest_predecessor_label: Re-Evaluating EVMbench; When Datasets Deceive; CyberChainBench
verified_overlap: Adjacent works show scaffold sensitivity, overlap-free re-evaluation, and strong historical-state benchmarking, but not the full survival ladder proposed here.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must quantify decay attributable to adding controls in a prespecified ladder, not merely report one strict split.
defeating_evidence: No reviewed predecessor was verified to present the full random-to-joint-independence-to-prospective survival ladder.
residual_uncertainty: A closer predecessor may exist in benchmark contamination or surveillance literatures outside the exact terminology used here.

component: Calibrated selective prediction with realistic workload
chronosaudit_requirement: Abstention, precision-coverage, calibration, alert budgets, and analyst workload under realistic base rates.
closest_predecessor_label: SCONE recent-contract experiment; selective-classification methods; security-ML base-rate work; FIRST EPSS; current SAST benchmarks
verified_overlap: Selective prediction, calibration, base-rate reasoning, rolling pre-outcome exploit probabilities, low-precision tool evaluation, and prioritization trade-offs are established; SCONE reports a mostly-negative recent-contract scan with cost and revenue accounting.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must show that a frozen selective policy, analyst-time accounting, and cost-sensitive decisions change under the joint smart-contract admissibility controls.
defeating_evidence: PA012 defeats novelty of smart-contract scan cost accounting; PA023-PA025 defeat methods novelty; PA033 defeats broad claims for operational exploit-probability prioritization; PA036-PA037 strengthen false-positive evaluation precedent; PA008 and PA022 defeat base-rate motivation novelty.
residual_uncertainty: Whether a smart-contract benchmark combines calibrated abstention, measured analyst workload, and joint contamination control remains unverified.

chronosaudit_requirement: Preregistered cohort, frozen model and retrieval process, frozen thresholds, repeated or sustained follow-up, independent adjudication, and responsible-disclosure-safe shadow study.
closest_predecessor_label: SCONE recent-contract zero-day experiment; Re-Evaluating EVMbench
verified_overlap: SCONE already goes beyond retrospective benchmarking: it scanned 2,849 recently deployed contracts in simulation, found two previously unknown vulnerabilities, reported costs and simulated revenue, and coordinated disclosure or rescue. Post-cutoff and scaffold-sensitive evaluation are also established.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must exceed a one-time scan by preregistering a longitudinal cohort and follow-up window, freezing retrieval and thresholds, preserving all predictions and abstentions, and using independent adjudication.
defeating_evidence: PA012 defeats novelty of a prospective recent-contract zero-day scan, realistic mostly-negative cohort, cost accounting, and disclosure coordination.
residual_uncertainty: The exact degree of SCONE model/scaffold freeze and any proprietary longitudinal security-vendor deployments remain incompletely verified.

chronosaudit_requirement: One auditable protocol combining prediction-time admissibility manifests; temporal, lineage, clone, proxy, attacker, and mechanism separation; exploit-specific censor-aware states; executable evidence; a survival ladder; calibrated workload-aware abstention; and longitudinal sealed prospective evaluation.
closest_predecessor_label: Closest composite: SCONE + CyberChainBench + Re-Evaluating EVMBench + clone/censoring/standards/EPSS/attacker-campaign and current benchmark predecessors
verified_overlap: Every major ingredient has a strong paper, benchmark, standard, operational system, or patent predecessor; no single reviewed public source was verified to combine the full interaction and measurement contract.
material_difference: ChronosAudit's credible novelty path is evidence that the joint machine-verifiable policy changes conclusions about capability survival, followed by a longitudinal seal stricter than SCONE's documented experiment.
defeating_evidence: The targeted search defeats novelty of real incidents, executable grading, post-release testing, duplicate filtering, right-censoring, pre-outcome exploit probability, workload prioritization, proxy checklists and clone recognition, attacker-contract analysis, campaign clustering, one-time prospective scanning, and disclosure coordination as individual ingredients.
residual_uncertainty: Patent coverage remains targeted; proprietary deployments and private protocols are inaccessible; bounded public-source absence cannot prove universal novelty.

chronosaudit_requirement: The contribution must remain materially distinct from public patent claims and recognized smart-contract security standards.
closest_predecessor_label: Duplicate-filtered smart-contract ML; state-space violation prediction; software exploit-likelihood prediction; OWASP SCSVS; EEA EthTrust
verified_overlap: Patent records cover code-duplication filtering, state-space-based smart-contract violation prediction and alerting, and machine-learning exploit-likelihood forecasting. Standards cover proxy-aware verification controls and tiered audit assurance.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must be claimed as an auditable scientific evaluation protocol, not as the invention of duplicate filtering, state-transition prediction, exploit likelihood modeling, proxy verification, or tiered security checklists.
defeating_evidence: A patent family, non-English claim, other standard, or private operational workflow could contain a closer benchmark contract than the targeted search exposed.
residual_uncertainty: Family-level legal analysis and private protocols remain out of scope; OWASP and EEA coverage closes the named public standards gap but not universal absence.

chronosaudit_requirement: A preregistered measurement study testing how much apparent exploit-detection capability survives the joint application of temporal, lineage, clone-family, mechanism-family, censoring, and operational-workload controls.
closest_predecessor_label: EVMbench and Re-Evaluating EVMbench; SCONE; CyberChainBench; When Datasets Deceive; FinSurvival; EPSS
verified_overlap: The closest public works separately cover executable exploit benchmarking, post-cutoff/scaffold re-evaluation, historical replay, overlap leakage, right-censored Web3 evaluation, and operational exploit prioritization. Attempt 8 did not verify one study measuring their joint capability-survival interaction.
material_difference: ChronosAudit must prespecify the joint estimand and show a nonredundant decision consequence beyond isolated leakage checks; prospective deployment is later validation, not novelty evidence.
defeating_evidence: An equivalent predecessor need only prespecify and measure temporal plus lineage/clone and mechanism/censoring/workload degradation with an interaction or decision consequence; identical tooling is unnecessary.
residual_uncertainty: Attempt-8 exact-match logs omitted query-level timestamps counts screening exclusions and a timestamped pre-ledger freeze; FinSurvival was not recovered in the bounded pass; one closest-work traversal and patent coverage remain incomplete.
